Usage heterogeneity of initiation zones

Source: R/iz_heterogeneity.R
compute_usage_heterogeneity.Rd

Per progress bin, the usage probability p of each IZ is the mean usage of the cells in the bin (ignoring NA). The heterogeneity is the cell-count-weighted mean of 4 p (1 - p) over the bins with a finite p (weights renormalised over those bins); without NA all bins are used.

Usage

compute_usage_heterogeneity(usage, progress, n_progress_bins = 10L)

Arguments

usage

Cells x IZs usage matrix (0/1/NA; base or sparse), e.g. call_iz_usage() or call_iz_usage_from_states().

progress

Replication progress of the cells.

n_progress_bins

Number of progress bins.

Value

A list with summary (IZ_id, mean_usage, usage_by_progress, usage_heterogeneity, n_usage_observed), by_progress, probability (bins x IZs) and progress_bin.
